text:
tenantx-support: Hey team — noticed a behavior change after last night's rollout. Replies are now dropping order IDs (e.g., `ORDER-52341` turned into `an order`) and appending an extra 'estimated' line. Also saw a short window of 401s around 2026-03-16T22:12:05Z. Correlation ID: req_0a1b2c3d. Region: us-west-2. Reported model: redwood-3b-v2.

alex: Thanks — sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste a minimal repro (prompt + exact API payload) and the request headers (x-request-id / Authorization redacted is fine)? Also include the prompt logs (system/user/assistant roles) for the failing calls.

tenantx-support: Pasting a redacted sample here. Will DM full logs per your request.
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-3b-v2",
  "input": "System: You are an order assistant.\nUser: Please confirm order ORDER-52341 shipped date and total.\n",
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "max_tokens": 120
}
Response (truncated):
"The order was shipped on 2026-03-10. Estimated delivery within 3-5 days."
```

maya: Do you know whether TenantX was pinned to a model or using routing preference? There was a canary that started ~21:48 UTC. If they used prefer_latest or a rollout policy we need that info.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started 2026-03-16T21:48:12Z for model redwood-3b-v2 -> redwood-3b-optimized, traffic 0% -> 20% over 30m.

eng-ml-ana: For repro please try two controlled requests: one to the pinned version you saw (redwood-3b-v2) and one to redwood-3b-optimized. Run with deterministic settings: `temperature=0`, `top_p=1`, `stream=false`, `max_tokens=200`. Include token counts (prompt_tokens, response_tokens) and the `model_version` header returned. This helps isolate behavioral vs sampling differences.

alex: Quick curl snippet you can use and paste back output + headers (redact tokens):
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b-v2","input":"User: Please confirm order ORDER-52341 shipped date and total.","temperature":0,"max_tokens":150}'
```
Please also include the raw `x-redwood-model` and `x-redwood-version` headers from the response if present.

tenantx-support: Sending a minimal repro now, pasted below. Latency spike observed ~800-1200ms (normally ~120-180ms) during the same window. Also saw several 401s for ~3 minutes — auth logs show token validation errors but only for a subset of requests (same time as canary).
```
Request headers:
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d
Region: us-west-2

Payload:
{"model":"redwood-3b-v2","input":"User: Confirm ORDER-52341 total","temperature":0,"max_tokens":80}

Observed response headers:
x-redwood-model: redwood-3b-v2
x-redwood-version: 2026-03-16-21:47
x-request-duration-ms: 1023
HTTP/1.1 200 OK

Body (what came back): "Total: $42.50. Estimated delivery within a few days."  <-- note missing explicit order id
```

alex: This is helpful — please open a support ticket with the full zipped prompt logs (retain role separation but redact PII tokens), the API gateway logs for the 401 window, and attach the account id + billing org id. We'll escalate to infra + ML if we can reproduce locally. :raised_hands:

eng-ml-ana: If you can, run one more experiment: send the exact same payloaded input to `model=redwood-3b-optimized` and `model=redwood-3b-v2` with `temperature=0` and attach both raw outputs. If behavior differs, include them verbatim — that'll confirm whether the canary variant changed decoding/assistant prompts.

tenantx-support: Understood — will collect and upload to the ticket. Expect the artifact bundle in ~30m. Thanks all. :eyes:
